description: Embeddable agent chat widget - allow agent creators to embed public agents on external websites via lightweight script tag

userStories.title: Backend: Embed config and token endpoints
userStories.description: As an agent creator, I need API endpoints that provide embed configuration and generate access tokens so my agent can be embedded on external sites.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /assistants/public/{id}/embed returns {agent_id, name, description, theme} without auth
POST /assistants/public/{id}/embed-token requires auth and validates owner
Embed token is a signed JWT with {agent_id, rate_limit, exp}
Non-owner gets 403 on token generation
Non-public agent returns 404
Existing tests pass (make test)
userStories.notes: Routes at backend/src/routes/v0/assistant.py. Use PyJWT for token signing.

userStories.title: Backend: Embed chat streaming endpoint with rate limiting
userStories.description: As an embedded widget, I need a chat endpoint that accepts embed tokens and streams responses within rate limits.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /assistants/public/{id}/embed-chat accepts embed JWT in Authorization header
Validates JWT signature and expiry
Streams response using existing streaming infrastructure
Returns thread_id for conversation continuity
Rate-limits per token using Redis counter
Returns 429 when rate limit exceeded
Existing tests pass (make test)
userStories.notes: Reuse streaming patterns from backend/src/utils/stream.py. Rate limit via Redis.

userStories.title: Frontend: Standalone embed widget build
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a separate Vite build target that produces a lightweight embed.js bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate vite.embed.config.ts produces frontend/dist/embed/embed.js
Bundle is IIFE format (self-executing)
Bundle size is <50KB gzipped
Widget reads data-agent-id from its own script tag
npm run build:embed produces the bundle
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Frontend: Embed chat widget UI
userStories.description: As a website visitor, I want a floating chat button that expands into a chat panel so I can interact with the embedded agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Floating button renders in bottom-right corner of host page
Clicking button expands to chat panel with message input
Messages stream from embed-chat endpoint
Thread ID stored in localStorage for continuity
'Powered by Orchestra' footer links to /a/{agentId}
Widget is visually self-contained (no CSS leaks to host page)
userStories.notes: Use shadow DOM or scoped styles to prevent CSS conflicts.

userStories.title: Frontend: Embed code snippet in agent editor
userStories.description: As an agent creator, I want to see embed code snippets in my agent editor so I can easily copy-paste the embed code for my website.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent edit page shows 'Embed' section for published agents only
Section contains copy-to-clipboard script tag snippet
Snippet uses correct agent ID
Hidden for unpublished agents
Typecheck passes (npm run build)

userStories.title: Tests for embed functionality
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests covering embed token generation, rate limiting, and widget loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: embed config returns correct fields for public agent
Test: embed token generation validates ownership
Test: embed chat rejects expired/invalid tokens
Test: rate limiting returns 429 after threshold
All tests pass (make test)
Lint passes (make format && make lint)
